subject: FY 2023 City Budget
overview: The Medford City Council Committee of the Whole met to review proposed FY2023 department budgets, including Police, Elections, IT, and Executive services. The Council voted to table the pensions and debt service budgets and passed motions requesting budget adjustments for a zoning consultant and videographer compensation.

items.title: Police Department Budget
items.summary: Police Chief Jack Buckley presented the proposed FY2023 Police Department budget, highlighting personnel adjustments, state-mandated training, software upgrades, and a grant-funded behavioral support unit.

items.title: Traffic Supervisors Budget
items.summary: Chief Buckley presented the level-funded $344,875 Traffic Supervisors budget covering 25 positions while discussing recruitment challenges for vacant roles.

items.title: Traffic Commission Budget
items.summary: The Council reviewed the level-funded Traffic Commission budget and discussed the workflow between traffic engineers and the commission on street design projects.

items.title: Elections Department Budget
items.summary: Elections Coordinator Sandy Gale and Chief of Staff Nina Nazarian reviewed the proposed elections budget, covering poll worker staffing, precinct changes, and department position classifications.

items.title: Chevalier Theatre Budget
items.summary: Chief of Staff Nazarian presented the level-funded Chevalier Theatre budget and noted that requested building repairs would be handled through capital improvement planning.

items.title: Licensing Commission Budget
items.summary: The Council reviewed the level-funded $5,800 budget for the Licensing Commission.

items.title: Bicycle Advisory Commission Budget
items.summary: The Council reviewed the level-funded $1,500 budget for the Bicycle Advisory Commission.

items.title: Insurance Budget
items.summary: Finance Director Bob Dickinson presented the proposed $27,938,312 insurance budget, reflecting a 5.6% increase driven primarily by employee health benefit costs.

items.title: Workers' Compensation Budget
items.summary: Director Dickinson presented the $646,000 workers' compensation budget, a 14.15% reduction following the resolution of prior-year claim settlements.

items.title: Pensions and Debt Service Budgets
items.summary: The Committee voted to table the pensions, debt service, and bonds and interest budgets until a meeting where all council members could be present.

items.title: Information Technology Budget
items.summary: Chief of Staff Nazarian reported that the city is refining the IT department structure and job descriptions ahead of hiring a permanent department head.

items.title: Legislative Budget
items.summary: The Council reviewed the Legislative budget and approved a motion requesting that the administration add funding for a phase two zoning consultant.

items.title: Executive Budget
items.summary: Chief of Staff Nazarian presented the Executive budget, detailing negotiated salary reserves and explaining that translation services will be funded through ARPA.
